rules.tokenization: lowercase ASCII [a-z0-9]+; existing STOP set; no stemming or synonyms
rules.acceptance: score > 0 only; no semantic support check
rules.baseline: unique query/document token intersection count on the same title + text, STOP set, positive-score filter and source-ID ties

evaluation.authoring: Freeze first; author and label the complete new question set before executing either retriever. Do not change rules, labels or questions after observing outcomes.
evaluation.source_recall: For answerable questions only: fraction with a labelled acceptable source in top k.
evaluation.false_support: For unanswerable questions only: fraction returning any record. This is a retrieval-as-support risk proxy, not semantic entailment or generated-answer error.
evaluation.empty_retrieval: Report empty results separately for answerable and unanswerable questions.
evaluation.independence: New authored confirmation questions, independent of parameter selection but not blinded or sampled from users; not population accuracy.
